alerts.title: Vance rallies for Paxton in Tyler

samples.text: JD Vance: If you ask Ken Paxton a simple question you will get a direct answer. https://t.co/L1aYXMUMeU
Thank you, @JDVance, for standing with me in East Texas today! America First will win in Texas. 21 days until Election Day. Come and Take It. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/RJnXVPUfIF
@JDVance said it best: Don’t mess with Texas! Help us continue the fight at https://t.co/cq3Qd9H9tX 🇺🇸 https://t.co/BDHwr855dU
